Method of Attack: Encrypts files on victim's computer by adding extensions .PEGS1, .MRCR1, or .RARE1 depending on variant
Distributed via SPAM emails pretending to be consumer complaints from the Federal Trade Commission
Downloads a zip file containing complaint.pdf.exe disguised as a PDF document
Encrypts targeted file extensions and creates ransom note YOUR_FILES_ARE_DEAD.hta set to autostart
Uploads victim computer information to https://onion1.host/cd/copy/gate.php
Attack Vector: SPAM emails with fake FTC complaint and malicious link to govapego.com
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious domains and URLs: http://govapego.com, https://onion1.host/cd/copy/gate.php, IP 81.4.123.67
